title.zh: 终身护保与长期护理（长期护理支持基金——规定公共计划）条例 2019
title.en: CareShield Life and Long-Term Care (Long-Term Care Support Fund — Prescribed Public Schemes) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1. These Regulations are the CareShield Life and Long-Term Care (Long-Term Care Support Fund — Prescribed Public Schemes) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 2 January 2020.
[S 851/2020 wef 01/10/2020]

2. For the purposes of section 39(1)(c) of the Act, the following schemes established by the Government are prescribed public schemes:
(a)the ElderFund Scheme;
(b)the Withdrawal from Medisave Account for Long‑Term Care Scheme (also known as the Medisave Care Scheme).
[S 851/2020 wef 01/10/2020]
